idea-plugin.name: CMP Resource Manager
idea-plugin.description:
Browse Compose Multiplatform resources in Android Studio through a native tool window.

  • Discover composeResources directories across modules and source sets.
  • Browse Drawable, String, String Array, Plurals, Font, and Files categories.
  • Group resources by name and compare density and locale variants.
  • Preview Vector Drawable XML as thumbnails and scalable images with original dimensions.
  • Search names and text, compare translations, and open XML declarations at their source lines.
  • Preview animated WebP with play/pause, transparency, and original dimensions, without JCEF.
  • Automatically refresh saved changes detected by the IDE while preserving filters and selection.

Open View > Tool Windows > CMP Resource Manager after installation. Requires IntelliJ Platform build 261 or later and the Android plugin. Tested with Android Studio 2026.1.4.

Source and documentation | Report an issue
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0

  • Render Vector Drawable XML thumbnails in the resource list and variant cards.
  • Open vector previews with transparency, preserved aspect ratio, original dimensions, and source navigation.
  • Native resource list and variant comparison across six categories.
  • Localized XML value previews and navigation to source declarations.
  • Animated WebP playback with transparent compositing and responsive previews.
  • Automatic resource refresh with preserved filters and selection.
